doc.title: Winard Harper interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 10, 2014

title: Wrap-up and promoting his group
summary: Harper takes help promoting his group and avoids Twitter.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: Well is there anything you’d like to wrap up with that I haven’t asked you about?
Oh not that I can think of. I think we covered quite a bit, unless there’s something that you want to go over.
How do you promote your own group? Do you have help with that?

I try to borrow help whenever I can get it. I take any help when I can get home to it. And I try to do the very best I can. I still get things printed up, try to do this social media thing, which a lot of times I have to ask either some youngsters or some people that are more in tune. Because still with some of the social media and computer stuff I probably might not ever, because when I hear people talking about tweeting and getting on Twitter, I can’t see myself just everyday, “hey I’m here” and you know.
